{{Quote|Ania, what are you doing? That thing's got no weapons! You're going to get yourself killed!|Sauk|<ref name="Legacy 3">[[Legacy (2013) 3|''Legacy'' (2013) 3]]</ref>}}
In [[138 ABY]], the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] owned a small, personal '''starship'''. She kept it with her at her [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junk yard]], but she brought it to an [[Carreras Minor ice mining platform|ice mining platform]] in the rings of [[Carreras Minor]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. There, she showed her friend [[Sauk]] an [[Unidentified Imperial communications droid|Imperial communications droid]] that she had found, and the two of them suddenly discovered a [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] inside of the [[Imperial communications droid|droid]]. They went to [[Carreras Major]] to sell it,<ref name="Legacy 1" /> but their attempts led to a getaway from [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|the law]], which saw them pilot Solo's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] through a sewer system. As Sauk, an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], had not fixed the ship's targeting lead, they only escaped when he used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut open a steam pipe and blind their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] pursuers.<ref name="Legacy 2" /> The ship was later loaded onto a [[AG-37's freighter|freighter]] that belonged to their friend [[AG-37]], but Solo jettisoned her ship from the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] cargo hold in order to destroy some [[Carreras starfighter]]s that were chasing them. The resulting explosion destroyed her starship as well.<ref name="Legacy 3" />
